name: Big Game Hunter

meta.previous: Panther Mastery (4), Raptor Mastery (4), Tiger Mastery (4)

summary: In Stranglethorn Vale, Hemet Nesingwary’s hunt for King Bangalash reaches its last trial. The famed marksman came to the jungle for the great white tiger.

sections.title: The Master's Quarry
sections.body:
You have slain Sin'Dall, Bhag'thera, and Tethis in the trials set by the expedition's huntsmen. Hemet Nesingwary now knows your skill with weapons. Few have shown him finer skill on Lordaeron's battlefields or deep in the jungle.

One hunt remains. Bring down King Bangalash, the great white tiger Hemet came to hunt, and prove your abilities unmatched.

sections.title: A Storied Beast
sections.body: King Bangalash drew Hemet Nesingwary to Stranglethorn Vale. The great beast has driven the expedition leader back to camp in defeat time and again. Its head would prove your hunting skill second to none.

faq.answer: Hemet Nesingwary gives this hunt at his expedition encampment in northern Stranglethorn Vale, after you finish the earlier hunting masteries.

faq.q: What prerequisite hunts must be finished first?
aliases: what quests come before big game hunter
faq.answer: First, finish all three hunts for the camp. Slay Sin'Dall in Tiger Mastery, Bhag'thera in Panther Mastery, and Tethis in Raptor Mastery.

faq.q: Why does Hemet Nesingwary want King Bangalash?
faq.answer: King Bangalash drew Hemet to Stranglethorn Vale. The great white tiger has eluded him repeatedly and driven the veteran marksman back to camp more than once.
Hemet requires King Bangalash's head as proof that you have slain the great white tiger.

faq.q: Where does Hemet say he has seen combat before?
faq.answer: Hemet compares your skill with weapons to what he has seen on Lordaeron's battlefields and deep in the jungle. He says he has rarely seen better.

angles.text: As a hunter, bringing down King Bangalash proves your mastery of tracking and the hunt to Hemet Nesingwary.
